title: Built a free city destruction sim with Claude Code, now with true city elevation and improvements following some great feedback. Give me more!
author: timcorin
selftext:
I've been building small things with Claude Code, and this one deserves the light of day: Judgement Day, a free city destruction sim that runs in your browser.

Choose any real city, pick a nuke, a meteor, a black hole, an Independence Day ship or a tornado, and watch the buildings blow apart into particles.

The part I've enjoyed most is how fast the loop is. I shared it last recently, people told me what they wanted, and within a couple of days cities were loading much faster and the ground had real elevation instead of being flat.

Still undecided on the look: everything is plain grey right now, like an architect's model. Textures are possible but cost smoothness on phones. Grey or textured, what do you prefer?

Would be keen on your thoughts of the rest of my project website as well.

Hope you get a laugh out of it!

[https://altroadstudio.com/judgementday](https://altroadstudio.com/judgementday)
